mapper.select: SELECT work_day FROM t_work_infos WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY work_day DESC

SELECT tw.work_day, tw.start_time, tw.break_time, tw.end_time, mwp.work_place FROM t_work_infos tw INNER JOIN m_work_places mwp ON tw.work_place_id = mwp.work_place_id WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND work_day LIKE CONCAT(#{workDay}, '%') ORDER BY work_day ASC
